CHIEF COMPLAINT
Status post mitral valve repair follow-up.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient is a 63-year-old female presenting for follow-up evaluation after mitral valve repair performed on 8/3/2020. At previous follow-up on 9/17/2020, patient was doing well from a cardiac standpoint. Patient reports feeling significantly better since surgery. She denies new symptoms but continues to experience occasional chest pain and shallow breathing with exertion. Episodes last only a few minutes and resolve with rest. She reports these symptoms occur approximately a couple times per month and has learned to slow down when they occur, after which she is usually able to resume activities. Patient is compliant with medications using a reminder app. She reports initial irritability with atenolol that has since improved. ECG from 12/26/2020 shows atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response and T-wave inversion anteriorly with no significant changes compared to previous study.

Patient denies new symptoms. Reports occasional chest pain and shallow breathing with exertion, lasting a few minutes and resolving with rest, occurring approximately twice monthly. Denies medication side effects except for initial irritability with atenolol which has resolved.
